wrote تصريف ثانٍ (V2)، والصحيح استخدام ا: Wrote is the past simple (V2). Here, use the past participle (V3): written.
ابدأ بالفاعل (I) ثم will have ثم التصريف: Start with the subject I, followed by will have and the past participle finished.
ابدأ بـ By the time dad arrives متبوعة ب: Start with By the time dad arrives followed by the main sentence.
الجملة صحيحة تماماً ولا يوجد بها خطأ! ✅: The sentence is completely correct and there is no error in it! ✅
الفاعل she يأتي بعده will have ثم submit: The subject she is followed by will have and then submitted.
الفاعل الجمع + will have + التصريف الثال: Plural subject + will have + past participle deployed + the deadline by next Friday.
تكوين السؤال: Will + you + have + V3 (gr: Question form: Will + you + have + V3 (graduated) + a future time expression.
جملة منفية: They won’t have arrived by n: Negative sentence: They won’t have arrived by noon.
سؤال: ابدأ بـ Will ثم الفاعل you ثم have: Question: Start with Will, then the subject you, then have completed.
في جملة by the time نستخدم المضارع البسي: In the sentence by the time, we use the simple present (arrive), not will arrive.
لا نستخدم has أبداً بعد will، بل have دا: We never use has after will, but always have.
